questions.question: Against which nation is the oracle in Isaiah 19?
What surprising blessing does Isaiah 19 foresee?
options: A new pharaoh who would honor the LORD
The utter and final destruction of all Egypt
Egypt, Assyria, and Israel together blessed by God
A long age of war among all the nations
questions.answer: Egypt, Assyria, and Israel together blessed by God

questions.question: Isaiah 19 says the LORD will make himself known to Egypt, and they will know the LORD in that day.
Behold, the LORD is riding on a swift cloud and comes to _____.
Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria My handiwork, and Israel My _____.
